summary: Canaan Loop Road site #3: the Forest Service page confirms the road is drivable ('Driving is permitted, although you should exercise caution, especially when in a low-clearance vehicle') and has no potable water; the Forest's camping reminder (via Parsons Advocate) lists Canaan Loop Road (FR 13) as a Cheat-Potomac developed-dispersed area, free, first-come, 14 days in 28. No current alert or forest order covers FR 13. No Forest Service page designates the individual numbered sites.
flags: No Forest Service page designates the numbered Canaan Loop Road campsites: the agency page (canaan-mountain-backcountry) describes the road, and the Forest's 2023 camping reminder (reprinted by Parsons Advocate / wvdn.com) names 'Canaan Loop Road (Forest Road 13)' among the Cheat-Potomac Ranger District's developed-dispersed camping areas. The site numbers are AWH's catalogue.

Vehicle suitability, quoted from the Forest Service: 'Driving is permitted, although you should exercise caution, especially when in a low-clearance vehicle.' That is a caution, not a high-clearance or 4WD requirement or recommendation; AWH stopped at site #1 twice in 2025 (note on entry 222). Aggregator reviews say the full loop may need 4x4 and the road is not big-rig friendly (few turnarounds); the northern part of the loop is private land (Allegheny Wood Products permission required), while these sites appear (by their coordinates) to lie on the southern section within a few miles of WV 32.

No current Monongahela alert or forest order names Forest Road 13 (alerts page read 2026-10-21; the FR 18 closure through 2026-10-26 is a different road). Missing phone: Cheat-Potomac Ranger District 304-257-4488 / 304-478-2000.
